authorizing_request: Rerun H1 with supplied macro controls, no time clusters; exclude index funds and compare equity/bond/mixed fund focus; disclose sentiment exceptions.
index_policy: EVER_INDEX: exclude the entire fund when any observed historical name/category/verified flag identifies indexing. Provisional source-classified/unknown remaining funds retained with explicit identification coverage; not claimed verified active.
focus_policy: Exact opening report explicit category first. Complete and valid full opening gross-portfolio fallback threshold80%; mixed requires stocks and bonds each20% combined80%. Never classify fund focus from single target security.
sentiment_policy: No matched dated title-name candidates, outside approved news scope, issuer unmapped, all irrelevant, classification errors/incomplete remain NA with separate reasons. Actual observed relevant balanced/neutral net0 retained. No fillingNAwith0.
macro_timing_policy: Daily economic/effective date<=actual closing date, lag<=7d. Exact IMOEX end/start return. Flow latest fully completed economic month; source label shifted one month back, rawRUB/1e9. Revised descriptive controls, not claimed real-time vintage.
unique_funds_scope: All true interval closing dates before index/news/sample filters
outlier_policy: Keep original rows; no winsorization, trimming or selection by p-values. Quantify residual-SS contribution of saved quality flags.
subgroup_inference: Core equity/bond/mixed p-values Holm-adjusted as one family. Secondary pooled net-by-focus interactions include group main effects when not absorbed and a joint equality Wald test.

pre_run_revision.reason: Explicitly specify runner default names and helper hashes before any actual fits.
